info.name: Alamal Medical Center - First-Version API
info.description: Manual verification for the approved Phase 6 first-version backend. Run php artisan migrate, php artisan db:seed --class=DevelopmentSeeder, and php artisan serve before testing with the committed fake development credentials. The default base_url is http://127.0.0.1:8000. These credentials must never be used in production. Successful login requests store tokens in role-specific collection variables.
